inputs.text: This is a power grab presented as legal reform. They’re pushing changes to Cyprus’ surveillance law that would remove judicial oversight, with a House vote expected Thursday. The fact that it was discussed in a closed session shows how much they want scrutiny kept out of sight. Lawyers are warning about it, but those steering the changes clearly see accountability as an obstacle. The secrecy is part of the plan.

output.main_topic: Proposed changes to Cyprus’ surveillance law and their effect on judicial oversight
